title: Zac Brown Looks Back on Duets With Dolly Parton and Chris Cornell on The Howard Stern Show
summary: Zac Brown joins Howard Stern for an exclusive interview and live performance on SiriusXM's Howard 100.
body_markdown:
[Zac Brown](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/zac-brown-band) joins[The Howard Stern Show](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/howard-stern) on Monday, November 16, for an interview and live performance on SiriusXM.


[Howard Stern Show Howard’s interviews, bits, and more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-HowardStern)


### **How to Listen**


Catch Zac Brown’s interview and live performance on *The Howard Stern Show* on Howard 100 (Ch. 100) and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-HowardStern) on Monday, November 16. The full show will also be available on the app afterward.


Earlier this month, Phish frontman Trey Anastasio[made his debut on The Howard Stern Show](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/trey-anastasio-to-make-his-howard-stern-show-debut-with-a-live-performance) , discussing his career, Phish, Bruce Springsteen, Neil Young, and more before delivering a live performance.


Zac Brown Band is currently on the Love & Fear Tour.[See upcoming tour dates](https://zacbrownband.com/pages/tour) .
